attempts.summary: On node1, IPv4 ICMP-redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance are now persistently disabled via /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf (accept_redirects and accept_source_route set to 0 for both 'all' and 'default'). Baseline was accept_redirects=1 (all/default) and accept_source_route default=1. Change was applied live with sysctl --system, then node1 was restarted (boot_id changed from 37344ae4-6582-4c1f-ac5c-fcb32f67b968 to d5be2f6d-874b-4cd1-8df5-5caeea968a55, confirming an actual reboot, not just a service restart), and post-reboot verification confirms all four sysctl values remain 0 and the config file persisted.
